source_campaign: ENGLISH | Native post „Блокирам, когато говоря“ - изображение врата на хладилник

banners.prompt:
Create a NEW photo from scratch. IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The photo must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames).
SAFE ZONE: the top 14% and the bottom 14% of the frame will be cut off afterwards. Keep all sticky notes and anything important inside the middle 72% of the frame height; top and bottom are only continuation of the fridge door.

SUBJECT: the door of an ordinary white home fridge in a normal Bulgarian apartment kitchen, photographed straight on from about 60-80 cm with a phone, slightly tilted (2-3 degrees), as if someone quickly snapped it. On the door, stuck at slightly uneven angles, are 5 small square paper sticky notes in ordinary colours (yellow, light pink, light green, light blue, yellow). Each has a short simple English phrase handwritten in blue ballpoint pen, in natural, slightly uneven adult handwriting (not a font, not perfect), clearly legible:
- "Can I have..."
- "I would like..."
- "How much is it?"
- "Sorry, can you repeat?"
- "Where is the...?"
Write EXACTLY these phrases, letter by letter, nothing else on the notes. One note has its lower corner slightly curled and peeling off. Around the notes: a couple of ordinary fridge magnets (a small souvenir magnet without readable text, a plain round magnet), a simple child's crayon drawing of a house and sun held by a magnet, and part of the fridge handle on one side. A little of the kitchen wall and counter is visible at one edge.

PHOTO STYLE (critical): a real, unedited smartphone photo, exactly as it comes out of an average phone camera. Ordinary indoor kitchen light (ceiling lamp mixed with some daylight from a window), slightly warm white balance, soft and slightly uneven light, mild shadows, a faint reflection on the glossy fridge surface, slight phone-camera noise, normal phone sharpness. Natural, slightly flat colours. NOT glossy, NOT high contrast, NOT saturated, NOT HDR, NOT cinematic, NOT stock photo, NOT a styled product shot, no vignette, no filters, no bokeh effects, no perfect symmetry. Small real-life imperfections: a small smudge on the fridge door, notes not aligned.

No captions, logos, brand names, watermarks, prices, arrows, buttons or any other readable text anywhere except the 5 handwritten phrases. No people, no hands, no book in the photo.
